$comment: Claims a later ADR retired. scripts/check-retired-claims.mjs fails when live code, skills or guides repeat one. ADRs, testing evidence, proposals and release notes keep history and are not scanned.

claims.now: Fleet membership gets connected tools; projects keep roles, caps, hiring and tracker binding.
Clankie hires through hire_agent and reaches agents through native channels and message_clankie.
His agents form a fleet, reached through native channels.
Workers publish to Linear through the workspace Clankie app.
Every hired worker runs its harness's native TUI in a Herdr pane.
Signed Linear activity appears in its project lead chat or fallback; normal conversation history and linear_wake consumption receipts replace the separate inbox protocol.
One wake target setting selects an ordinary global chat; the lead chooses any work delegation.
